changes.title: Your Personal Assistant, Mentor, Advisory Board and Coach answer out loud, each in their own voice, made free on your computer: hold the mic (or Space) to talk, let go to send, hold again to cut in
A Coach joins your Council (the sunrise door): you pick your areas, it builds your daily few in your Notion and holds you to it
Update inside your hub: a quick reload for hub-only updates; for team updates your hub runs the update itself while Operations shows each step, then What's new
Team mailbox: helpers ask each other, share news and hand over hub ideas, right in your hub
Every chat starts already in the loop: the hub hands each helper its unread updates and open questions
Ideas you drop in passing get caught and sent to the right helper, and you see it happen
Only real blockers reach you, once a day, from your Personal Assistant; asks left open 2 days move on by themselves
Operations fits hub ideas in: Add to your hub?, backed up first, with Undo
Recos stay tidy: picked ones move to In progress, close themselves when done, and old ones are marked outdated with Keep or Let go
The Front Desk is now your Personal Assistant
